name: Well of Lost Dreams
oracle_text: Whenever you gain life, you may pay {X}, where X is less than or equal to the amount of life you gained. If you do, draw X cards.
blocked_sentences: Whenever you gain life, you may pay {X}, where X is less than or equal to the amount of life you gained. If you do, draw X cards.

needs.what: an optional mana payment made while a triggered ability resolves in which the player announces X (0..a ceiling given by a value expression, here {"binding": "amount"} from the you_gain_life trigger), pays {X} generic, and the chosen X is bound (e.g. `as: "x"`) so the if-you-do effects can read it -- draw {"binding": "x"} cards
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `may` with `pay` charges a fixed Cost, and `pay.times` only scales it by a value the card computes, not one the player chooses, so it could force X = life gained but not allow any smaller X. `ask_x` (the choose_x decision) exists only at cast/activation time in game.py, not as an effect op. `may` with `repeat` around pay {1} + draw 1 interleaves draws with payments (information the printed card does not give), has no ceiling at the life gained, and `repeat` with a count would let a player decline then accept.
